title: Here's Why You Shouldn't Run From The Police #5
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On November 29, 2022, an officer attempted to pull over a speeding vehicle in Wauwatosa, WI. They refused to pull over and lead police on a pursuit which shortly ended after they were struck by another vehicle at an intersection. As police attempted to place him into custody, the suspect initially complied with commands but decided to make one last shot at escaping. 

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
